entries.name: canonical-betta-shopify-session-bridge
entries.note: Canonical Fred/NTA Shopify session bridge as observed 2026-10-15 (read-only inspection). Any change to this file is a re-pin event requiring explicit owner authorisation; deployment wiring of this checker into write paths is owner-gated.

known_copies_observed.note: Agent-writable workspace copy used by Fred's ad-hoc merch scripts during the P1 incident. Contains a merch write path and an in-file BETTA_MERCH_TARGETS/BETTA_MERCH_VALUES allowlist that does not exist in the canonical bridge. Informational only; check_bridge() must return bridge_not_canonical for this path.
